ChatGPT Space is a shared workspace where people and AI create and maintain living documents together.

Work often gets scattered across chats, docs, files, and updates. Space keeps context, collaboration, and AI assistance in one place. Instead of treating AI as a separate chat tool, Space lets you tag ChatGPT, Codex, or your dot directly inside a shared page to edit, research, code, or take next steps.

Features

Self-updating pages for writing, visualizing, research, and coding.

Real-time team editing, comments, and AI tagging in the same document.

Shared knowledge hub for files, pages, slides, spreadsheets, and team context. [...] Dots integration to keep pages updated across ChatGPT, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.

Templates for to-do lists, project dashboards, and onboarding-style workflows.

Who it’s for: Teams and professionals on Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans who collaborate on plans, research, projects, and documentation.

Use cases: Build project dashboards, onboarding prototypes, campaign plans, visual research pages, and self-updating to-do lists.

Try Space and see how AI can become part of your team’s workflow.

# People and AI working together

Space helps you create living documents with ChatGPT and the people you work with. Keep work in one shared space, where you can tag in ChatGPT, Codex, or your dot to help—and build on shared context together. Collaborative slides and spreadsheets coming soon.

Available on Pro, Business, and Enterprise plans.

Explore Space

Video 1

## Create, collaborate, and build together

### Powerful, self-updating pages

A new type of document built for work you do with agents—write, visualize, research, and code. Pages can stay updated from your connected tools, so you can focus on the work, not updating the doc.

### Work together with AI [...] ### Work together with AI

Edit pages with teammates in real time, leave feedback in comments, and tag ChatGPT or your dot to make changes or take on next steps—all in the same page.

### A home for shared knowledge

Bring your team’s files, pages, slides, spreadsheets, and more into one shared place. ChatGPT and your dot can use that context to help your team build on what’s already done.

## See what’s possible when ChatGPT is part of the team

Image 1: An onboarding prototype displayed on a shared page in Space, with teammate cursors and a sidebar.

### Visualize anything on a page

Visualize prototypes, research, data, or key decisions right on a page. Edit together with your team and tag ChatGPT, Codex, or your dot to work through changes. [...] ### Collaborate on slides with your team and AI

Turn a conversation into slides using your team’s template. Edit with teammates, add feedback, and ask ChatGPT to revise the slides, keeping everyone working on the same deck.

_Collaborating slides are coming soon._

### Shared context for your team and agents

Bring your team’s goals, plans, and designs into one shared space. Ask ChatGPT or your dot to keep dashboards updated, turn a teammate’s design into engineering tasks, or flag blockers. New work your team creates builds on shared context.

More from ZDNET

## Space, Pages, and slides

ChatGPT Space is “a new home for your team to collaborate with AI to get work done,” OpenAI said in a blog. Users can work with ChatGPT, other teammates, and a new agentic feature called Dots. Pro, Business, and Enterprise users can start trying ChatGPT Space today on the desktop app and the web.

OpenAI said mobile access is on the way.

Also: How to use ChatGPT Work – and my top 10 tips for getting started with agentic AI

Pages and collaborative slides, both new today, are “built for human and agent collaboration,” OpenAI said. Each lets users create documents and presentations with ChatGPT’s generative abilities, including on-page research, graphics, and images. [...] Anthropic absorbed Cowork back into Claude to create a more seamless, one-stop shop for users’ agentic needs, but the tool’s initial purpose made sense for workplace use cases. OpenAI’s new features appear to follow the same thinking, though the company is hesitant to fully claim any productivity suite plans.

“Space is built for people and AI to work on the same content together,” an OpenAI representative told ZDNET via email. “Pages are a format native to ChatGPT that AI can read and create, and that teammates can edit together in real time. Today, people develop ideas in ChatGPT, move the work elsewhere to share it, then bring feedback back to ChatGPT. Space brings that process together so people can create, share, and keep working with their team and ChatGPT in one place.” [...] Skip to content
